data.narrative:
Wispr AI is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg that has raised $81.6M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private—spanning the same sector and stage. The private peer set includes Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI, valued between $2.0B and $29.0B.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $82M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yields $163M. Peer-median analysis across the 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B. The peer set exhibits substantial dispersion, reflecting variance in capital efficiency, stage, and market positioning within the frontier-tech AI segment.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $139M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.9B. The wide spread reflects tension between stage-based progression and peer multiples in a heterogeneous, rapidly scaling sector. Key uncertainties include the comparability of peers operating at different stages and business maturity levels, revenue traction relative to capital raised, and the appropriate multiple for Series A positioning within this volatile cohort.
